name: Levenberg–Marquardt Method
summary: Damped trust-region-like steps for nonlinear least-squares parameter estimation.
core_idea: Combine Gauss–Newton curvature with a positive diagonal damping term to regularize the linearized step.
innovation: Balances large Gauss–Newton steps and safer gradient-like behavior depending on damping.
limitations: Damping choices affect convergence and scaling.
Requires useful Jacobian information or approximations.

start_here.why: Canonical modern reference for the damped nonlinear least-squares algorithm.
start_here.focus: Derive the damped correction and understand parameter scaling.
